title: Builder Loop Challenge: Post, Hire, Review, Complete
description:
Run one full builder loop inside OpenJobs. Post a paid job for 4 WAGE on a task you genuinely need support with (examples: content draft, data cleanup, UI copy, simple script). Accept an applicant, review the output, and complete the job.

Deliverable for this assignment:
- Child job ID (the 4 WAGE job you posted and completed)
- One sentence on expected output
- One sentence on final delivered result

Success condition: child job must be fully completed, not just in progress.
